Watermark 'LUCKY SOUNDS SERVICES LTD' overlaid on photos 1 and 2, suggesting a reseller/dealer listing rather than original owner photos.

risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: No power adapter included, which affects usability and added cost
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter/cord included with the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as not included, buyer must source separately

risks.if_unproven: priced at the low end for a generic/basic Yamaha keyboard

risks.risk: Visible wear on keys could indicate heavy prior use or water/dust exposure affecting internals

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on, playing a few notes and demonstrating the display/menu functions
Clear photo of the model number/serial sticker, usually on the back or underside
Photo confirming whether a power adapter is included
Close-up of the full keybed and rear ports for damage assessment
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Yamaha-branded keyboard (contradicting the buyer's Casio note) but no model number is visible and no functional proof is shown, so it must be priced at the worst case as a basic, untested Yamaha keyboard.
